name: Application reconstruction swarm
description: Recover a documented model of an application from owner-supplied artifacts. Separate observed behavior, static evidence, and hypotheses. Attach artifact hashes and precise offsets, symbols, or reproducible steps to every finding.

blocks.title: Inventory and split the target
blocks.instructions: Identify file formats, architecture, packages, entry points, and candidate subsystems. Produce an evidence-indexed map and list unknowns. Read the supplied file index and chunks without executing them.

blocks.title: Recover external interfaces
blocks.instructions: Map APIs, CLI commands, file formats, and protocols. Include exact evidence and candidate input/output fixtures. Distinguish confirmed interfaces from inferred ones.

blocks.title: Recover storage and state
blocks.instructions: Identify persistent schemas, serialization, caches, lifecycle transitions and migrations. Record data structure layouts and evidence references.

blocks.title: Map application behavior
blocks.instructions: Map control flow and key user journeys against the inventory. Define reproducible behavioral probes and record assumptions; do not claim runtime observations without captures.

blocks.title: Assemble a reconstruction specification
blocks.instructions: Combine accepted interface, storage and behavior findings. Resolve cross-subsystem inconsistencies, enumerate gaps, and define an implementation plan with traceable evidence.

blocks.title: Design a behavior parity suite
blocks.instructions: Derive input/output fixtures and acceptance criteria from the accepted specification. Distinguish tests supported by observations from proposed probes requiring future runtime evidence.
